newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Mountain View-Los Altos, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Mountain View-Los Altos, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received on behalf of the County of Santa Clara, California (the County'') by the Director or the Director's designee, and on behalf of the Mountain View-Los Altos Union High School District (the District''), for the purchase of $2,000,000* principal amount of Mountain View-Los Altos Union High School District, County of Santa Clara, California 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes at the hour of 10:00 A.M., Pacific Daylight Time, on

at the office of Sutro & Co. Incorporated, 555 South Flower Street, Suite 4630, Los Angeles, California 90071. In the event that no bid is awarded, the County and the District will receive bids each successive Wednesday at the same time and location until such time as a bid is awarded or the County and the District determine to withdraw sale of the Notes.
